Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Brinyn Wyrai: 32-year-old woman, 174 cm (medium), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: square compact face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, long-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
